PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (12.0, 8.0, 18.0),      # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (0.8, 0.3, 1.5),        # diff pair L
    "Lp":    (1.0, 0.4, 2.0),        # PMOS mirror load and M7 L
    "gmidp": (10.0, 7.0, 14.0),      # PMOS load / M7 gm/Id
    "Itail": (30e-6, 15e-6, 60e-6),  # tail current
    "I7":    (150e-6, 80e-6, 220e-6),# second-stage current
    "Cc":    (1.2e-12, 0.5e-12, 3e-12),
    "rz_k":  (1.3, 0.8, 3.0),        # Rz = rz_k / gm7
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    Ln = 1.0
    gmidn = 10.0
    Itail, I7, Cc = p["Itail"], p["I7"], p["Cc"]
    Ib = Itail / 2

    mb = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, iref, vds=0.65)
    m5 = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, Itail, vds=0.25)
    m8 = lut.size("n", gmidn, Ln, I7, vds=0.9)
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], Ib, vds=0.5)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], Ib, vds=0.9)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmidp"], p["Lp"], I7, vds=0.9)

    Rz = p["rz_k"] / m7.gm

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "n1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "d2", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d2", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "n1", "d2", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "n1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "n1", "nz", Rz)
    n.C("CC", "nz", "vout", Cc)

    gm1, gm7 = m1.gm, m7.gm
    A1 = gm1 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    A2 = gm7 / (m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1 * A2)
    ugbw = gm1 / (2 * PI * Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m3.cdd + m1.cdd + m3.cgd
    C2 = cl + m7.cdd + m8.cdd
    p2 = gm7 * Cc / (C1 * C2 + C1 * Cc + Cc * C2)
    pmir = m3.gm / (2 * m3.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd)
    wu = 2 * PI * ugbw
    zden = Cc * (Rz - 1 / gm7)
    zphase = math.degrees(math.atan(wu * zden)) if zden > 0 else -math.degrees(math.atan(wu * abs(zden)))
    p3 = 1 / (Rz * C1) if Rz * C1 > 0 else 1e12
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p2)) - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / pmir)) \
         - math.degrees(math.atan(wu / p3)) + zphase
    power = 1.98 * (iref + Itail + I7)
    slew = min(Itail / Cc, I7 / (cl + Cc))
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "power": power, "slew": slew}
